payload.title: Close stable wide residual datum screen
payload.decision: Reject H012 and close T016 without a new feature/model refit. Preserve E011 unchanged. Do not retune the tested E009 action families, scales, caps, feature counts, or subgroup-specific placement rules.
payload.rationale: Nested E009 actions retain a real +0.057790 RMSE gain over E011 with 5/5 maps and 21/25 cells, but regress spatial group 3 by 0.091016 and typewell group 0 by 0.097205. All controls and 12 edge groups pass, and independent reproduction is exact. The frozen every-spatial and every-typewell gates therefore fail.
payload.revisit_trigger: Only materially new evidence or a new causal representation outside the tested E009 action space may justify another residual-datum experiment.
